subtitle: Amapuzzle eziqhingi nolwandle
short_description: Hlukanisa ibhe ye-4×4 ibe ulwandle neziqhingi ezilingene ngobukhulu.
description:
Maka wonke amasikwele ebhe ye-4×4 njengolwandle noma umhlaba. Iqhingi ngalinye elinenombolo linamasikwele afana kanye nenombolo yalo futhi liqukethe isikhombisi esisodwa; ulwandle lwakha umzimba owodwa oxhunyiwe, futhi akukho ibhulokhi ye-2×2 egcwele ulwandle.

Thepha isikwele esingenalutho ukuze ujikeleze phakathi kolwandle, komhlaba nongenalutho. Amasikwele esikhombisi aqinile.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
